style: Vintage 1990s Hong Kong movie Mandarin dubbing, a young heroine around 20: clear, bright, sweet voice with good projection, light chest resonance and natural airiness (not whispery), soft Taiwan-style Mandarin cadence. Expressive and melodic like film dialogue, romantic longing with a subtle playful charm and a touch of sadness; natural, not slow; delicate yet firm sentence endings. Close-mic. Same tone throughout.
act: Delivery: a real human narrator, moving but restrained, like quietly telling a memory. Keep the pitch level and steady across the whole passage: no sudden rise or extra emphasis anywhere, especially keep 人生中的问题也是解不完的 calm and low like the rest. Natural light breaths, moderate pauses. A hint of weariness on 一件完了，一件又来, then calm, tender acceptance.
text: 每个人一辈子，都有许多不顺心的事，一件完了，一件又来。所以，丁香结年年都有。结，是解不完的；人生中的问题也是解不完的，不然，岂不太平淡无味了吗？
